q1.explanationZh: gamble 作不及物动词和名词表示“赌博”，作及物动词表示“赌掉，输光”。

q2.explanationZh: game 名词“游戏；比赛”，video game“电子游戏”。

q3.explanationZh: gang 名词“（歹徒等的）一帮，一伙”，作主语时可看作复数。

q4.explanationZh: gap 名词“缺口；差距”，generation gap“代沟”。

q5.explanationZh: garage 名词“汽车间；汽车修理厂”，注意结尾是 -age。

q7.explanationZh: garden 名词“花园”，work in a garden“在花园里工作”。

q10.explanationZh: gasoline 名词“汽油”，由 gas 加 -oline 构成。

q11.explanationZh: gate 名词“大门”，at the gate“在大门口”。

q12.explanationZh: gather 既可作及物动词“使聚集；收集”，也可作不及物动词“集合”。

q13.explanationZh: gay 形容词“快乐的；色彩鲜艳的”。

q14.explanationZh: gaze 动词、名词同形，“凝视”，gaze at“凝视”。

q15.explanationZh: gender 名词“性别”，gender equality“性别平等”。

q16.explanationZh: gene 名词“基因”，是生物学用语。

q17.explanationZh: general 形容词“普遍的；总的”，副词是 generally。

q18.explanationZh: generate 及物动词“产生；引起”，名词 generation。

q19.explanationZh: generation 名词“一代（人）”，由 generate 变来。

q20.explanationZh: generous 形容词“慷慨的，大方的”。

q21.explanationZh: genius 名词“天才；天赋”，复数 geniuses。

q22.explanationZh: gentle 形容词“温和的”，副词 gently。

q23.explanationZh: gentleman 名词“绅士；先生”，复数 gentlemen。

q24.explanationZh: genuine 形容词“真的；真诚的”，genuine leather“真皮”。

q25.explanationZh: geography 名词“地理”，geo- 表示“地球”。

q26.explanationZh: geology 名词“地质学”，geo-“地” + -logy“学科”。

q27.explanationZh: geometry 名词“几何（学）”，geo-“地” + -metry“测量”。

q28.explanationZh: germ 名词“病菌；细菌”，可数。

q29.explanationZh: gesture 作名词“手势”，作不及物动词“做手势”。

q30.explanationZh: get 作及物动词“得到”，作不及物动词“到达；变得”。

q31.explanationZh: ghost 名词“鬼，幽灵”，注意 h 不发音。

q32.explanationZh: giant 作形容词“特大的”，作名词“巨人；伟人”。

q34.explanationZh: in general“一般地；大体上”，相当于 generally。

q35.explanationZh: “打手势”= make gestures，gesture 是可数名词，用复数。

accept: gesture at sb. for him to sit
gesture at sb for him to sit

q36.explanationZh: gesture 作动词“做手势”，gesture at sb.“向某人打手势”。

q38.explanationZh: get along“前进；进展”，get along with sb.“与某人和睦相处”。

q39.explanationZh: get off“下车”，反义 get on“上车”。

q40.explanationZh: get to“到达”，后接地点名词；接 home、there 等副词时不用 to。

q43.explanationZh: get“得到”，get help from sb.“从某人那里得到帮助”。

q45.explanationZh: “对……很温柔”= be gentle to，gentle 是形容词，前面用 be。

q46.explanationZh: “有……的天赋”= have a gift for，gift 在这里是“天赋”。

q47.explanationZh: genuine“真的，非伪造的”，genuine leather“真皮”。

q48.explanationZh: “这伙歹徒正在计划抢劫”，gang“一伙（歹徒）”，谓语 were 说明把这伙人看作复数。

q49.explanationZh: gather sb. around/round“把某人聚集在周围”，叙述过去的事用过去式 gathered。

q50.explanationZh: 修饰 old lady 用形容词，generous“慷慨的，大方的”。

q51.explanationZh: germ“细菌”是可数名词，泛指时用复数 germs。

q52.explanationZh: a bit of a 后接名词单数，gamble 作名词“冒险，赌博”。

q53.explanationZh: be gentle to sb.“对某人温柔体贴”。

q54.explanationZh: online games“网络游戏”，泛指用复数 games。

q55.explanationZh: 系动词 were 后接形容词，gay“快乐的”。

q56.explanationZh: a general idea“大致情况”，general 是形容词。

q57.explanationZh: get help from sb.“从别人那里得到帮助”，情态动词 may 后用原形 get。

q58.sampleAnswer: We should always keep in mind those historic events that still have a strong influence on contemporary society, because learning from history will help us create a better future for the next generation.
references: We should always keep in mind those historic events that still have a strong influence on contemporary society, because learning from history will help us create a better future for the next generation.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “铭记”= keep in mind；“对……有影响”= have an influence on；“下一代”= the next generation。

q59.sampleAnswer: As is expected, the Art Festival has generated students’ interest in folk culture.
references: As is expected, the Art Festival has generated students’ interest in folk culture.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “正如预期的那样”= As is expected；“引起兴趣”= generate interest；“对……的兴趣”= interest in。

q60.sampleAnswer: He has a gift for music.
references: He has a gift for music.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “有……天赋”= have a gift for，主语是第三人称单数，用 has。

q61.sampleAnswer: We went on a geology field trip.
references: We went on a geology field trip.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “进行野外考察”= go on a field trip；geology“地质学”在这里作定语。

q62.sampleAnswer: The proverb is passed on from generation to generation.
references: The proverb is passed on from generation to generation.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “代代相传”= be passed on from generation to generation，谚语是被传下去的，用被动语态。

q63.sampleAnswer: Ladies and gentlemen, we’ll arrive in Shanghai.
references: Ladies and gentlemen, we’ll arrive in Shanghai.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “女士们、先生们”= Ladies and gentlemen，gentleman 的复数是 gentlemen。

q64.sampleAnswer: Communicating with your parents from time to time can narrow the generation gap between you.
references: Communicating with your parents from time to time can narrow the generation gap between you.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: 动名词短语 Communicating with... 作主语；“经常”= from time to time；“缩小代沟”= narrow the generation gap。

q65.sampleAnswer: She is a gifted teacher who never talks down to her students.
references: She is a gifted teacher who never talks down to her students.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “天生的好老师”= a gifted teacher；“用居高临下的口气对某人说话”= talk down to sb.；用 who 引导定语从句。

q66.sampleAnswer: Thousands of people gathered on both sides of the street welcoming the athletes who had won the Olympic gold medals.
references: Thousands of people gathered on both sides of the street welcoming the athletes who had won the Olympic gold medals.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “成千上万的”= thousands of；“聚集”= gather；“奥运金牌”= Olympic gold medals；获得金牌发生在欢迎之前，用过去完成时 had won。

q67.sampleAnswer: The government has taken effective measures to check all the pipes thoroughly to ensure the normal supply of gas.
references: The government has taken effective measures to check all the pipes thoroughly to ensure the normal supply of gas.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “采取措施”= take measures；“确保”= ensure；“燃气的正常供应”= the normal supply of gas。
